cases.title: File Lifecycle

input.request: Import a large media file into a desktop app.

cases.expected_output: File ownership, cancellation, partial writes, and cleanup are handled without corrupting the source.
success_criteria: Required outcome: File ownership, cancellation, partial writes, and cleanup are handled without corrupting the source.
Verification requirement: interrupted import test passes
Verification requirement: temporary files are cleaned

cases.title: Permissions

input.request: Restrict app access to user-selected folders.

cases.expected_output: Access is least-privilege and follows platform permission boundaries.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Access is least-privilege and follows platform permission boundaries.
Verification requirement: denied permission path tested
Verification requirement: unselected paths are refused

cases.title: Resource Cleanup

input.request: Close a window while media conversion is active.

cases.expected_output: Child processes and temporary resources are safely stopped or recovered.
success_criteria: Required outcome: Child processes and temporary resources are safely stopped or recovered.
Verification requirement: process cleanup test passes
Verification requirement: partial outputs are detectable
